title: A Great Way Off
description: King Nebuchadnezzar raises a golden statue and commands everyone to bow before it.

title: And Ruth With Her
description: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego refuse to bow to anyone but God.

title: Into His Hand
description: The king orders the furnace heated seven times hotter than usual.

title: One Thing Thou Lackest
description: In the flames a fourth figure walks with them, and they are unharmed.

title: The Fourth Man in the Fire
description: They step out untouched, and the king praises the God who rescued them.
